candidates.change_summary: Change the comparison to strictly greater-than so deposits equal to MinDeposit are rejected; replaces 'if(msg.value >= MinDeposit)' with 'if(msg.value > MinDeposit)'.
Remove the minimum-check so any msg.value (including 0) is accepted; replaces 'if(msg.value >= MinDeposit)' with 'if(true)'.
Invert the conditional so deposits meeting the minimum are rejected; replaces 'if(msg.value >= MinDeposit)' with 'if(!(msg.value >= MinDeposit))'.
Remove the balance overflow require check so deposit may overflow; delete the require statement.
Log the deposit before updating balances so History sees message prior to state change; move TransferLog.AddMessage above balances increment.
Make Deposit non-payable check effectively require positive value by inserting a require that msg.value > 0 causing revert for zero-value calls.
Change the deposit condition to require msg.value strictly greater than MinDeposit (from >= to >), so deposits equal to MinDeposit are rejected and balances unchanged.
Remove the require overflow check so a deposit no longer performs that defense before updating balances.
Swap order to log before updating balances, so observer-visible log may show old balance ordering differences (log happens prior to state change).
Change increment to set balances[msg.sender] = msg.value (overwrite instead of add), so Deposit replaces balance rather than increases it.
Invert the if condition to only accept deposits when msg.value < MinDeposit, changing which deposits update the balance.
Replace the order: transfer ether to msg.sender before decrementing the sender's balance (moves the balance subtraction after the external call).
Remove the balance subtraction so balance remains unchanged after successful cashout (no decrement of balances[msg.sender]).
Change the conditional to require strictly less than, disallowing cashout of the full balance (use _am < balances[msg.sender]).

Change the external call to use transfer-style revert on failure by requiring success (move require around call) — use require on call result instead of manual if and revert only on failure after log.
